description: § 1(h)(6)(A): a rental building given up (straight-line depreciation $120,000; the building's FMV $300,000, adjusted basis $100,000) with its land for $400,000 of real property plus $60,000 cash; total adjusted basis $150,000. Recognized gain $60,000, no recapture, all § 1231 gain — and all of it unrecaptured § 1250 gain (smaller of the $120,000 depreciation and the building's $200,000 gain).
